text:
ellie: Quick heads-up — onboarding aquila-v0.7 (q4a) to staging. Ran the zh->he translation evalsuite and saw a ~6 BLEU drop vs fp32 baseline on our locale testset. looks bidi-ish, not just token merge.
samir: Could you paste a couple of failing examples? emoji? :eyes:
ellie: pasted two minimal repros below, they look like punctuation/bracket mirroring + token merge across CJK/Hebrew boundary.
jia: oh wow. CJK punctuation (fullwidth comma/period) is ending up on the wrong side of Hebrew clauses after decoding. also some tokens are getting merged into single ids during q4a tokenization step (see ids)
ellie: example 1 input:
```
我有两个问题：מה קורה?
```
fp32 output: "我有两个问题: מה קורה?"  (Hebrew kept RTL order, colon attached to zh side)
q4a output: "我有两个问题 ?מה קורה:"  (mirrored punctuation + colon moved)
q4a token ids (tokenizer.decode(ids) shows): [1012, 2356, 9999, 30021, 40012] — note token boundaries look different compared to baseline
samir: can you dump tokenizer ids for fp32 vs q4a for that sentence? maybe we accidentally use a merged vocab table for quantized artifact.
jia: pasted tokenizer id diffs — fp32 and q4a use same vocab but the BPE merges differ because we apply a post-quant merge pass in the build. suspect bug in the merge pass that treats neutral-direction punctuation as RTL when adjacent to hebrew glyphs.
marco: also check detokenization step — we have a small RTL reflow helper that runs post-decode for RTL scripts. maybe it's applying to mixed CJK+Hebrew incorrectly. last time that helper caused parentheses mirroring.
ellie: repro command I used:
```
./eval_run --model aquila-v0.7-q4a --task zh->he --batch 64 --dataset locale-mix-2026 --metrics bleu,chrF
```
ci-bot: eval pipeline finished: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/45213 (report attached)
samir: does the BLEU delta persist with batch=1 / no kv-cache? try with --batch 1 --kv-cache off
ellie: tried batch=1 + kv off — delta reduced to ~2 BLEU but still present. so batching/kvcache exacerbate but not sole cause.
jia: plan proposal:
- reproduce minimal pipeline with raw tokenizer only (no reflow) to confirm merge vs reflow
- run float32 vs q4a token-sequence diff for 200 examples
- run bisect on the quant merge pass (turn off post-quant BPE merge)
- add targeted unit test for neutral punctuation boundary handling
marco: agree. I'll take the reflow helper audit. I'll add debug logs when charset transitions CJK<->Hebrew.
ellie: i'll run token-sequence diffs now and post a small sample in this thread.

ellie: sample diff (fp32 vs q4a):
```
FP32 ids: [213, 1456, 3000, 4000, 78] -> tokens: [我, 有, 两个, 问题, ：]
Q4A  ids: [213, 1456, 3000, 400012]   -> tokens: [我, 有, 两个, 问题：מה]
```
ellie: you can see the trailing fullwidth colon merged into the following Hebrew chunk in q4a path.
samir: interesting. merging punctuation into RTL token causes downstream reflow to treat punctuation as RTL-attached. that explains colon flip.
jia: quick mitigation: patch tokenizer postprocess to not merge neutral punctuation with following RTL cluster; add explicit split for CJK punctuation codepoints.
marco: if that fixes unit tests we can roll to canary then monitor BLEU on staging.
ellie: assigning tasks: jia -> tokenizer patch & tests, marco -> reflow audit + logs, samir -> run bisect on quant merge flag, ellie -> reproduce baseline diffs + regression dashboard update.
ci-bot: ticket created: INF-2147 "aquila-v0.7 q4a: CJK<->Hebrew punctuation merge causes BLEU drop" assigned to eng-ml team.
ellie: adding note — prioritize since this affects mixed-locale support for marketplaces. will follow up with triage notes tomorrow. :spiral_calendar:
